description: Canonical event schema for the herdr-fusion-bridge. Every event carries a correlation tuple { taskId, executorId, paneId }, a monotonic seq, and a state kind. seq is per-emitter monotonic. taskId/executorId/paneId may be "unknown" when the dimension is not resolvable, never dropped.

fields.kind: string, one of: start | progress | blocked | error | stalled | completed | engine_absent | association_stale
fields.ts: number, epoch millis when the event was observed
fields.payload: object, optional, shape depends on kind

progress.meaning: a discrete state/event change (REAL progress; log lines are NOT progress)

blocked.meaning: the task reached a blocked/waiting state or the watchdog declared it stalled

completed.meaning: a task/executor reached a terminal success state

engine_absent.meaning: the Fusion engine could not be detected; all downstream reconcile/steer work is suspended

association_stale.meaning: the pane or executor for a task could not be resolved
